topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I came across something rather unexpected today—my very own college application essay, displayed like a trophy on the program’s official site. They must have thought it was exemplary, showcasing the kind of prose that earns a nod from admissions officers. It’s all there, word for word, the nights of pouring over sentence structures, the struggle to encapsulate my essence on paper. It’s almost flattering, in a peculiar way, to see my words presented as a guide for others. Yet, there’s a part of me that can’t help but question how I became the anonymous author of their standards.
